messages:
Rina (PM): Quick thread to define a 'fast-pass' onboarding lane vs the full-entry gates. Customers keep asking for faster turnarounds for small models. Need concrete acceptance checklist differences.

Tom (SWE): Proposal: fast-pass applies to models that are embed-only or <250M params and not enterprise-licensed. Requirements: perf smoke (p95 < 300ms), sample perf 200, basic error rate <1%, 48h tenant canary, automated fallback enabled.

Lena (Data): Add eval sampling guidance: fast-pass can use focused domain samples (200-300) but must include at least one non-en-US locale if claimed. Full-entry still needs 1k multi-locale.

Harpreet (SRE): Ops caveat: even fast-pass needs auto-mitigation hooks and billing alerts. We can't skip telemetry entirely; require 7d retention for fast-pass and a cost spike alert (>30% vs baseline).

Ben (CS): From support: customer comms template for fast-pass that explicitly calls out a shorter pin window (60 days) and a migration assistance opt-in. Also want a simple rollback contact list.

onboard-bot: Created checklist ticket #6220 https://redwood/tickets/6220 (fast-pass lane)

Rina (PM): OK so differences summarized: fast-pass = sample 200-300, 48h canary, 7d telemetry, 60d pin. full-entry = sample >=1000, 14d+ canary (2 tenants), 30d telemetry, 90d pin default. Anything else?

Tom (SWE): Document must include a model-variant compatibility flag and a migration operator in catalog metadata: e.g., "compat:vector-stable/v1". That helps automated routing and canary selection.

Lena (Data): Also require a basic benchmark payload for both lanes (JSON snippet) and a standard csv format we can ingest for the catalog dashboard.

Harpreet (SRE): Add a mandatory runbook template for full-entry and a trimmed runbook for fast-pass. Fast-pass runbook can reference auto-rollback play only. Full-entry runbook must include manual escalation steps.

Rina (PM): Prioritization rule: auto-approve fast-pass requests up to N=5 per week; above that they go to a triage queue. We'll monitor abuse.

Ben (CS): +1. Request a short SLA blurb for external docs: "fast-pass models may be subject to shorter pin windows and limited backward-compat guarantees."

Rina (PM): I'll turn this into ACs in #6220 and assign owners: Tom -> ingest/bench schema; Harpreet -> runbooks/alerts; Lena -> sampling docs; Ben -> customer template. Sync tomorrow 9:30. :calendar:
